page.overview:
Who is Chiyomatsu?

Chiyomatsu holds some admiration for shinobi.

Chiyomatsu wears the standard samurai attire consisting of a helmet and face mask which completely obscures the face and grey samurai armour. He also carries two sets of swords with him strapped to his leg armour.

As a samurai, Chiyomatsu wields a sword and is skilled in its use, preferring to catch his enemies off guard with a single strike from above.

During the Five Kage Summit, Chiyomatsu and several other samurai are mobilised to look for the infiltrating Sasuke Uchiha. During the search, he leaves his group to investigate behind a pillar. Seeing a silhouette, Chiyomatsu rushes forward to strike but merely discovered a cloak, which was a lure to draw him away from his group. While still being bewildered and believing the team to have already left, Chiyomatsu is knocked out from behind by Sasuke's surprise attack.
